ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 60% high-intensity white pixels and 40% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white regions occupy the central 75% of both lobes. The left lobe contains multiple discrete, low-intensity circular focal spots. The right lobe shows a more fragmented boundary between high and low intensity pixels with significant mottling along the upper margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations are present along the continuous trailing edge of both lobes, characterized by varying peak amplitudes and distinct V-shaped indentations particularly on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward trajectory curving from the submerged center toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of roughly circular, high-intensity white pixel aggregates are located on the distal tips and along the leading edges of both lobes, indicative of barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several light-colored, diagonal linear pixel disruptions are visible across the dark pigmented border of the left lobe, with additional dark linear marks within the white field of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustations on lateral margins and multiple parallel rake-mark scars on the left lobe's pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Three distinct, isolated low-intensity circular spots located in the lower-central white field of the left lobe.
